conclusion: The typed V2 ledger owner and exact replay mechanism exist. Agentd's default canonical runner has no authorized Decision/Outcome writer owner or durable retention of the original authenticated append request; this remains an open P1 composition boundary.

findings.evidence: Default runner/provider and retrieval sink are None. Configuration accepts explicit host-owned injection and does not infer keys or authority. Root's exact a640 construction search found no production AgentdIntelligenceInvocationProviderV1 implementation.
The Ready { .. } branch returns canonical_ready and does not retain the prepared object, submit authenticated Decision, invoke a configured native executor, or append an authenticated Outcome.

All mutations are gated by qualification-legacy-learning-write and use DurableLedger::append_qualification. Removing the gate would bypass the intended typed V2 role/evidence owner and is not an authorized implementation.

Pending retains a legacy LedgerEvent, original predecessor and canonical snapshot in memory only. Prepared retains candidate ids but not the full original completeness/policy/state request or Generator/Observer evidence. Runner retains slots/authority verifier/optional evaluation trust only; no LedgerWriter owner.

One externally injected LedgerWriter lives behind a private Mutex and exposes retrieval-assignment operations. It does not expose authenticated Decision/Outcome, witness reopen, or generic recovery authority. Borrowing this owner for D/O would be an unsupported authority transfer.

Construction consumes a durable backend, independent witness and activated root-authenticated trust, and syncs directories. Decision verifies original Generator evidence/completeness; Outcome verifies original Observer evidence and independence from the active Decision.

At one-event witness lag, only the exact last event with its original predecessor may replay. Arbitrary new events or predecessor changes reject WitnessLag. Success is returned only after witness advance; IndeterminateAfterLedgerCommit retains the ledger receipt and witness error.

The persisted event contains authentication_digest, not the complete original SignedLearningEvidenceV1, signature and all original request fields. A new process cannot reconstruct the exact typed retry solely from the committed event.

The bridge delegates to LedgerWriter and preserves the original expected head. verify_active_decision_binding checks active record_id and episode_id; it does not by itself prove equality of the original canonical snapshot, policy, candidates, selection, or complete runtime tuple.

smallest_safe_future_handoff.prerequisite: A real startup/composition owner must explicitly supply an already-authorized LedgerWriter and original Generator/independent Observer requests. No default key, receipt, trust, currentness or retrieval authority can be synthesized.
smallest_safe_future_handoff.decision: Validate the exact frozen prepared canonical snapshot plus original durable runtime tuple, policy, selected candidate/propensity, candidate set/completeness and support; retain the complete ProductionDecisionV2, original SignedLearningEvidenceV1 and original predecessor before invoking the existing LedgerWriter::append_decision.
smallest_safe_future_handoff.outcome: Obtain the original independently authorized Observer request for the actual terminal/measurement fact. Physical Completed alone is not a signed learning value. Bind the exact active original Decision and tuple, then use the existing append_observed_outcome_v2 / LedgerWriter owner.
smallest_safe_future_handoff.durable_intent: Use a specified owner-local durable request format and exclusive owner lock. Fsync complete original request bytes and containing directory before any append. Retain version, exact original signatures/principals, predecessor, trust/owner identity and immutable run binding; never reconstruct from current head or fresh owner data.
smallest_safe_future_handoff.acknowledgement: After typed append and independent witness success, durably acknowledge the same request identity. Lost acknowledgements retain the original request for exact replay, with no new id, predecessor, signature or redispatch.
smallest_safe_future_handoff.cold_recovery: Reopen the same locked backend and independent witness with legitimately activated current trust, load the exact original request, then retry the same typed method. Expired/revoked evidence or mismatched owner/tuple stays pending or rejects under existing rules; do not fabricate a replacement proof.

changed current owner/run identity, revoked or expired signature, observer/controller non-independence
receipt loss exact retry without duplicate event or physical redispatch
